newsitem.title: USA: Prudential Insurance loses $4.5 bln pact - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Prudential Insurance loses $4.5 bln pact - WSJ.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co of America lost an exclusive $4.5 billion health-care contract with the American Association of Retired Persons (AARP), the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday.
Prudential lost the contract, which it has held since 1981, to three other bidders: United HealthCare Corp, Metropolitan Life Insurance Co and ITT Hartford Group Inc.

The AARP contract, which Prudential still holds until 1997, represents about 30 percent of the revenue for Prudential's health care unit and contributed about $40 million in pretax profit last year, the article said.
